title: Hotel Breakfast Room Ambience in Cartagena, Colombia - Crowd Walla, Plates and Cutlery Clatter (AB Stereo) by cesar-gutierrez-99
author: cesar-gutierrez-99
sourceDescription: Busy breakfast room ambience recorded at Oz Hotel, Cartagena, Colombia. Features a dense walla of multiple conversations, constant movement of plates and cutlery, and the general hustle of a hotel buffet. High-pass filtered to remove low-frequency rumble. Recorded with Primo EM272Z1 omnidirectional mics in AB stereo (30cm spacing).
modifications: cut 135.24-150.24s window; mono 22050 Hz; MP3 48 kbps; peak gain +0.00 dB (peak -12.40 dBFS); 30 ms fades
